activity_statements.statement: operates multi-amenity fitness and wellness clubs across Virginia, Pennsylvania, and South Carolina offering cardio, strength training, and 120+ group fitness classes per week
provides indoor and outdoor aquatics facilities, waterparks, and swimming programs including competitive summer swim teams for members
staffs personal trainers, group fitness instructors, tennis professionals, and childcare workers across 13+ club locations
operates a licensed year-round preschool and summer camp programs for children at Adventure Central campus in Charlottesville, VA
offers tiered membership plans (Fitness Only, Full Facility, All-Inclusive) plus discounts for students, seniors, and corporate partners including Renew Active for Medicare members

name_reality_gap: The name and 'Recreational Facilities' label accurately describe the core activity. Less obvious: the childcare, licensed preschool, and summer camp operations at some campuses make acac also a youth education and daycare provider.
extraction_notes: acacfitness.com domain timed out repeatedly; profile built from acac.com (same company, alternate domain found via Exa search). Good detail on membership offerings and facility types. Revenue ~$10M and ~357 employees from Exa entity data.
